decision9.reason: Decision 9's pre-agreed outcome is a function of three measured numbers (query wall time on ~200000 .ready files, view-switch latency, verbose-panel A/B cost against the master binary). None could be taken — the stand is unreachable and the CI fixtures cannot substitute: 200000 dummy .ready files would have to be created in a live cluster's archive_status directory under a pg_monitor-only role with a concurrent recorder, which is exactly the stand scenario. Choosing either branch — 'throttle' or 'acceptable, register the remainder' — without the numbers would be the shrug Decision 9 was written to forbid.
decision9.carryForward: The measurement stays an open obligation of feature 017. It must be run on the next reachable stand BEFORE the merge, under the conditions fixed in Decision 9 (a superuser run measures the wrong baseline: for pg_monitor the change is zero->full, not 1x->2x).

findings.title: go.mod still marks github.com/spf13/pflag as // indirect although a test now imports it directly
findings.expected: go.mod lists pflag in the direct require block, and the working tree stays clean after a build
findings.actual: cmd/report/report_test.go (task 4) imports github.com/spf13/pflag, but go.mod was not updated. Any build or test run with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod — including the documented docker invocation and this developer's local `make build` — rewrites go.mod, leaving ' M go.mod' in git status. It was already dirty when this QA session started.
findings.reproduction: git stash; make build; git status --short  ->  M go.mod (pflag moves out of the indirect block)
findings.impact: Cosmetic. A default (readonly) build, vet and test on the committed go.mod all succeed — verified in a clean worktree of HEAD — so CI does not break; the annotation is simply stale and makes every build dirty the tree.

findings.title: Two files are gofmt-dirty — pre-existing, not this feature's doing
findings.actual: report/report.go (trailing whitespace on the blank line at :304) and internal/stat/procpidstat_test.go. Both are identically dirty in master and in develop, i.e. they predate feature 017; the feature's own change to report/report.go is one line in the describe map at :675.
findings.owner: pre-existing repo hygiene, no task of this feature
findings.impact: None on the gate: the golangci-lint v2 config declares a formatters section with no linters enabled, so gofmt is not enforced and make lint stays green. Reported so 'lint clean' is not read as 'gofmt clean'.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: Decision 9 cost measurement and its pre-agreed outcome
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Needs ~200000 dummy .ready files in a live archive_status directory, a pg_monitor-only role, verbose mode and a concurrent pgcenter record
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Stand with sudo access to the cluster's archive_status directory
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: archive_mode=off; create ~200000 empty NNNN.ready files (empty files only — 200000 real segments is ~3 TiB); measure (1) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE name LIKE '%.ready') FROM pg_ls_archive_statusdir(), (2) the w view-switch latency with archiver open, (3) the verbose panel on an unrelated screen A/B against the master binary. Then apply Decision 9: bad numbers -> throttle via verboseCollectState + latencyGuardThreshold as its own decision; acceptable -> record the remainder for the tech-debt register. Delete the dummy files BEFORE restoring archive_mode.
